description: Passenger Vessel Density is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment. Data provided by the Marine Institute, and may also incorporate data from other agencies and bodies. The Vessel Density maps in the EU were created in 2019 by Cogea for the European Marine Observation and Data Network (EMODnet). Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment. Its tags are Marine Spatial Planning, National Marine Planning Framework, open data, passenger, shipping. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
